name: 08104 · Camden, NJ
findings: ZIP 08104 (Camden) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08104 (Camden) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08104 (Camden) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08104 (Camden) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
